purpose: Add a protected exact-main REG.RU preflight for the independent TAI service that runs automatically after canonical image publication, inventories production readiness, publishes a redacted exact-SHA status and evidence, and never changes containers, Compose files, PostgreSQL, model services, secrets or network topology.
requiredBehavior: run automatically only after a successful canonical image workflow for an exact current main push
allow a separate owner-only manual strict run with the confirmation phrase
verify the canonical TAI image tag digest revision label and rootless identity before SSH
pin the REG.RU production SSH host key to the protected fingerprint and require the protected production principal
discover production Compose authority from running container labels without exposing protected paths
require running API and web OCI revisions to equal the exact target main SHA
inventory service topology host resources and stable runtime state without changing production
verify existing API to private local model health without printing model endpoint or credentials
inspect only relations in the public PostgreSQL schema inside an explicit read-only transaction
require exactly one active governed knowledge generation
bind active model profiles to the configured model identity
bind every current accepted admission to each active profile exact artifact digest
snapshot stable container state and protected Compose file hashes before and after inspection
emit only redacted machine-readable evidence explicit blockers and a bounded exact-main commit status
fail closed when a required deployment prerequisite is absent
run a pull-request contract gate without using production secrets
narrowWriteAuthority: GitHub commit status write only for the context TAI REG.RU Preflight
